verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SVG audit tools and logo test sheets (pixel, one-colour and contrast checks) that the skill applies to the logos it generates. These check design outputs at runtime; they are not tests or evals that guard the skill itself against regressions when it changes. No test suite, eval harness or CI regression checks for the skill are documented, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection maintains tests or evals for its skills so changes are verified against regressions rather than shipped on vibes
